data: Reuse verified v1 Train-main/Train-dev teacher cache; reserved roles remain inaccessible

numerics.forward: n=floor(max(v/theta,0)); no spike cap or state clamp
numerics.surrogate: dn/dv=1/theta for v>0, zero otherwise; approximate positive-rate STE
numerics.reset: v_residual=v-theta*stop_gradient(n); forward charge is conserved; temporal surrogate slope is one
numerics.synapses: hidden and head receive theta*n; input stem, grid, width, decay, and phase queries match v1
numerics.readout: pre-reset head voltage, two max prototypes per class, one-time bias; no logit clipping
numerics.selection: raw-logit comparisons on a fixed grid; no sigmoid rounding before decisions
numerics.diagnostics: Current/voltage/spike maxima and RMS, candidate logit saturation, pre-clip gradients, weight norms
numerics.failure_policy: Stop on nonfinite or explicit catastrophic limits before optimizer.step; retain last completed epoch, write failure diagnostic

interpretation: Stability revision combines a numerical contract and a lower learning rate; not an isolated causal ablation or an accuracy improvement claim
